subject: [PATCH v3 08/11] scsi: mpt3sas: Cache the missing delays the IOC actually uses

2026-11-18.patch_summary: This patch fixes an issue in the mpt3sas driver where cached delays do not match the actual delays used by the IOC (Input/Output Controller) when the WRITE_CURRENT request fails and the WRITE_NVRAM request succeeds. The patch updates the mpt3sas_base_update_missing_delay function to read back the delays from the SAS IO Unit Page 1 after writing them, and cache the correct values if the read is successful. If the read fails, it assumes the requested delays are used if the NVRAM update succeeded. This ensures that the device_delay sysfs attribute reports the correct value.
